documents.name: SpotiFLAC Mobile
documents.subtitle: FLAC Downloader for iOS
documents.description: SpotiFLAC Mobile is an open-source Spotify track and playlist metadata downloader and FLAC converter for iOS and Android. Search and download high-quality FLAC and MP3 audio with complete ID3 metadata, embedded album artwork, and synchronized lyrics directly on your device.

documents.name: uYouEnhanced
documents.subtitle: uYouPlus with even more features!
documents.description: uYou is the best tweak for the YouTube app. uYouEnhanced is a modified version of qnblackcat's uYouPlus & MiRO92's uYou with even more features. Additional features include skipping sponsorships in videos, more PiP options, unlocking higher resolutions, disabling overlays, removing upsell alerts, dimming the UI, enabling the miniplayer, preventing notch issues, configuring A/B settings, and adding a timestamp button.

documents.name: YouTubePlus
documents.subtitle: Lightweight YouTube tweak with no ads and PiP
documents.shortDescription: Lightweight YouTube tweak with no ads and PiP
documents.description: YouTubePlus (formerly YTLite) is a lightweight enhancer for YouTube developed by Dayanch96. It provides complete ad blocking, background playback, offline video and audio downloads, Picture-in-Picture (PiP), SponsorBlock integration, gesture controls, and customizable interface settings.

documents.name: YouPro
documents.subtitle: Feature-rich YouTube tweak by alibusut
documents.description: YouPro is an advanced YouTube modification tweak developed by alibusut. It features background playback, ad-free streaming, inline download capabilities, OLED true dark theme, SponsorBlock, and enhanced media playback controls.

documents.name: YTKillerPlus
documents.subtitle: Advanced YouTube tweak with extensive controls
documents.shortDescription: Advanced YouTube tweak with extensive controls
documents.description: YTKillerPlus is an advanced feature-packed YouTube tweak by iKarwan. It offers comprehensive ad blocking, background playback, high-speed downloads, PiP, custom player actions, OLED dark theme, and granular privacy controls.

documents.name: YTKACE
documents.subtitle: YTKACE
documents.description: YTKACE is a free, open-source YouTube enhancer and downloader for iOS. No ads, background playback, video and audio downloads, SponsorBlock, Picture in Picture, player gestures and deep interface customization.

documents.name: YouMod
documents.subtitle: All-in-one YouTube enhancement tweak
documents.description: YouMod is a customizable YouTube enhancement tweak by Tonwalter888. It includes ad blocking, background playback, PiP support, UI customization, integrated download manager, and sponsor segment skipping.

documents.name: MaxTube
documents.subtitle: YTPlus with ten extra tweaks
documents.description: MaxTube (formerly YTPlusM) is Mark02-2012's fork of YTPlus/YTLite, the enhancer for the YouTube app on iOS. On top of the YTPlus feature set — video/audio/thumbnail downloads, SponsorBlock, PiP, YTUHD, YouQuality, Return YouTube Dislike, YTABConfig, DontEatMyContent and over 100 configurable options without a subscription — MaxTube integrates ten extra tweaks: YTweaks, Gonerino, YouSpeed, YTLowContrastMode, VolumeBoostYT, YouGetCaption, YTPlaybackFix, YouChooseQuality, YouShare and PleaseDontStopTheMusic. Settings live inside YouTube under Settings.

documents.name: YTMusicUltimate
documents.subtitle: Lightweight YouTube Music tweak
documents.description: YTMusicUltimate is a lightweight enhancer for YouTube Music by Dayanch96. It unlocks background audio playback, removes in-app advertisements, enables premium audio streaming quality, and provides customizable player themes.

documents.name: MaxMusic
documents.subtitle: YTMusicUltimate with extra tweaks
documents.description: MaxMusic (formerly YTMUltimate+) is Mark02-2012's fork of Dayanch96's YTMusicUltimate for the YouTube Music app on iOS. It keeps everything YTMusicUltimate provides — no ads, background playback, download manager, audio quality selection — and adds Return YouTube Music Dislike, YouMusicPiP, YTMABConfig and VolumeBoostYT, plus fixed in-app downloads on newer YouTube Music versions. Settings live inside YouTube Music under Settings.

documents.name: UTM
documents.subtitle: Virtual machines for iOS
documents.description:
Run real operating systems on your iPhone or iPad. UTM is an open-source (Apache-2.0) virtualization and emulation platform built on QEMU, capable of running Windows, Linux, classic Mac OS and dozens of other systems alongside your apps.

Highlights:
- QEMU v10.0.2 backend with support for dozens of CPU architectures (x86_64, ARM64, RISC-V, PowerPC and more)
- Improved machine wizard with well-tested configurations such as Windows, Ubuntu, RISC-V64 Ubuntu, classic Mac OS 8.x/9.x and Windows 95/98
- Custom keyboard shortcuts (e.g. Ctrl+Alt+Del) sent directly to the VM from the Keyboard menu
- App Intents automation with the Shortcuts app
- Liquid Glass design on iOS 26
- Import and export .utm virtual machine bundles via the Files app
- No jailbreak required; highest performance with JIT workarounds on supported iOS versions

documents.name: iNKillerPlus
documents.subtitle: Instagram with downloads, ghost mode and no ads
documents.shortDescription: Instagram with downloads, ghost mode and no ads
documents.description: iNKillerPlus is a modified Instagram by iKarwan. Download posts, reels, stories and DM media, save profile pictures, block promoted posts and ads, toggle seen/unseen for stories and DMs, ghost typing, hide tabs, copy comments and bios, confirmation prompts before liking or calling, and a profile analyzer. iPadOS supported.

documents.name: TTKillerPlus
documents.subtitle: TikTok with downloads, no ads and region switch
documents.shortDescription: TikTok with downloads, no ads and region switch
documents.description: TTKillerPlus is a modified TikTok by iKarwan. Download videos from the feed, stories and Explore, save photos and profile avatars, merge post photos with their music, block promoted posts and ads, toggle seen/unseen, hide tabs, browse the feed of a specific country, show country flags and post dates, and auto-like in live streams. iPadOS supported.

documents.name: Winston
documents.subtitle: Open-source Reddit client
documents.description: Winston is a beautiful open-source Reddit client for iOS built in SwiftUI, with themes, gestures, an inline media viewer and a fast comment thread reader. Because Reddit charges for API access, Winston asks you to create your own free Reddit API credentials on first launch.

documents.name: iTorrent
documents.subtitle: Torrent client with a built-in player
documents.shortDescription: Torrent client with a built-in player
documents.description: iTorrent is a fully featured open-source torrent client for iOS. It keeps downloading in the background, integrates with the Files app, supports magnet links, sequential download and per-file selection, and ships a built-in VLC-based player with Picture in Picture, audio and subtitle tracks and playback speed control.

documents.name: StikDebug
documents.subtitle: On-device JIT enabler and debugger
documents.description: StikDebug attaches a debugger to your sideloaded apps directly on device, which enables JIT for emulators and other apps that need it. It uses a pairing file and an on-device VPN loop, so no computer is required after the initial setup. Requires iOS 17.4 or newer.

documents.name: BHTwitter
documents.subtitle: X (Twitter) with no ads, downloads and the chronological timeline
documents.shortDescription: X (Twitter) with no ads, downloads and the chronological timeline
documents.description: BHTwitter is a long-running tweak for X (formerly Twitter), published as a ready-to-sideload IPA. It hides promoted posts and ads, restores the chronological timeline as the default, and lets you download videos, GIFs and images straight from a post. It also adds Face ID / Touch ID app lock, custom fonts, undo posting, inline translation, direct saving of profile pictures and headers, confirmation prompts for likes and reposts, and switches for hiding the tabs and UI elements you never use.

documents.name: LiveContainer
documents.subtitle: Run iOS apps without actually installing them
documents.shortDescription: Run iOS apps without actually installing them
documents.description: LiveContainer runs other iOS apps inside itself instead of installing them, so a single app slot on your certificate can host many sideloaded apps and you stop burning through the 3-app limit. When JIT is available it bypasses codesigning entirely; otherwise guest apps are signed with the same certificate as LiveContainer. It supports multiple data containers per app, tweak injection, adding guest apps to the Home Screen, and multitasking windows on iPadOS 16 and later.

documents.name: Feather
documents.subtitle: On-device app manager, signer and installer
documents.shortDescription: On-device app manager, signer and installer
documents.description: Feather is a free on-device iOS and iPadOS application manager built with UIKit. Import your own developer or enterprise certificate to sign and install IPAs directly from the device, add AltStore-compatible repositories to browse and update apps, keep a library of signed and imported apps, and tweak bundle identifiers, display names, icons and injected dylibs per app - no computer or AltServer required.

documents.name: SideStore
documents.subtitle: AltStore fork that refreshes apps without a computer
documents.shortDescription: AltStore fork that refreshes apps without a computer
documents.description: SideStore is a fork of AltStore that signs and refreshes sideloaded apps directly on the device. After a one-time pairing-file setup it renews 7-day certificates in the background using your own Apple ID and an anisette server, so apps stop expiring while you are away from a computer. It installs apps from any AltStore-compatible source, keeps them updated, and can back up and restore app data.

documents.name: Aidoku
documents.subtitle: Free and open-source manga reader
documents.description: Aidoku is a free and open-source manga reader for iOS and iPadOS with no ads and no tracking. Content comes from community-maintained source lists that you add yourself, so nothing is bundled with the app. It downloads chapters for offline reading, syncs library, history and settings through iCloud, supports external trackers, and offers paged, vertical and continuous reading modes with customisable layouts.

documents.name: Provenance
documents.subtitle: Multi-system retro game emulator
documents.description: Provenance is a multi-emulator front-end covering Atari, Bandai, NEC, Nintendo, Sega, SNK and Sony systems from a single library. It handles save states, cheats, MFi and native game controllers, Metal-based scaling filters, per-core settings, and imports your own ROMs and BIOS files through the Files app, iCloud or its built-in web uploader.
